results.title: Arlit mine - Wikipedia
results.snippet:
The Arlit mine is a large mine located near Arlit, in the northern part of Niger in Agadez Region. Arlit represents one of the largest uranium reserves in Niger having estimated reserves of 47.5 million tonnes of ore grading 0.014% uranium.

results.snippet: Africa’s highest grade uranium ore comes from the twin mining towns of Arlit and Akokan on the border of the Sahara desert. Mining in Arlit began in 1971. Three years later, operations were expanded to the nearby town of Akokan. Today, Akokan boasts the largest underground uranium mine in the world and Niger supplies around 7.5 % of world uranium.
